author: Informal_Librarian_7
body: Yep i did it for 234 to 250 woth a little bit of towering. Everything was in full exp gear. I accept that as a summoner i have a slight cheat code but it still requires dedication. Before realising i cam put up full boost buffed summons i reached floor 175 in endless pretty consistently (now about 300+ each time). With a exp shrine i was hitting 60bil a dungeon, but they arent that common so it was 15bil a dungeon and with 5 cued up 85bil an hour. Towering is more exp efficient. For example in full exp gear with a shrine the fallen hera boss gives 2 bil a battle so a full tower getting 3 or 4 is 6-8bil and kobold lord is also very good for exp as well as arisen king meliodas. Now im 250 though i just run dungeons to farm event stuff and end of dungeon rewards as well as the fact dungeons completed contribute a massive amount to global rankings.
